messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: Yuki and Diego make up team Cinder.
- [2025-04-09] standup/cinder/2025-04-09: On-call rotation: Yuki Tanaka is primary for the Cinder team starting today; Diego Alvarez is off rotation.
- [2025-01-14] standup/cinder/2025-01-14: Yuki takes the first team Cinder on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-10-27] standup/cinder/2025-10-27: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Diego hands the pager to Yuki.
- [2025-07-10] standup/cinder/2025-07-10: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2025-04-29] standup/cinder/2025-04-29: For anything Cinder-related, page Yuki.
- [2025-05-19] standup/cinder/2025-05-19: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-02-21] standup/cinder/2025-02-21: Rotation day for team Cinder: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez. Team Cinder saw that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-12-05] standup/cinder/2025-12-05: Team change: Diego Alvarez leaves team Cinder and joins Ember, effective today.
- [2025-04-07] standup/atlas/2025-04-07: Team Atlas on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Atlas starting today; Priya is off rotation.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-07-30] standup/dune/2025-07-30: Rotation day for team Dune: Farah Haddad hands the pager to Tomasz Nowak.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04: Team Dune on-call swapped this morning. Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The indexer lives with the Cinder team.
- [2025-04-16] standup/boreal/2025-04-16: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus Oyelaran hands the pager to Lena Fischer.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-09-22] standup/dune/2025-09-22: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for the Dune team starting today; Tomasz Nowak is off rotation.
- [2026-02-19] standup/boreal/2026-02-19: As of today Marcus Oyelaran is on the Atlas team; team Boreal loses a pair of hands.
- [2025-07-02] standup/atlas/2025-07-02: Tomasz has transferred to Dune. Team Atlas continues without them.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18: Oskar Lind picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-08-01] standup/boreal/2025-08-01: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus hands the pager to Lena.
- [2025-12-29] standup/ember/2025-12-29: Rotation day for the Ember team: Oskar hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-08-29] handover/2025-08-29-scheduler: Ownership change: the scheduler now sits with team Cinder. Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-10-31] standup/atlas/2025-10-31: Team Atlas runs its planning on Tuesdays.
- [2025-11-17] handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction: The 2025-11-07 note about the reporting service named the wrong team. The Ember team took it over on that date; team Boreal did not.
- [2025-11-13] handover/2025-11-13-ledger: The ledger has a new home: team Ember. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Reminder from Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-04-23] standup/atlas/2026-04-23: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.

Question: Which team is Yuki on?

message.reasoning:
The question asks which team Yuki is on. Looking at the memory entries:

- [2025-01-08] Yuki and Diego make up team Cinder.
- Various entries show Yuki on team Cinder rotations through 2025.
- [2025-12-05] Diego Alvarez leaves team Cinder and joins Ember - that's Diego, not Yuki.

There's no entry showing Yuki leaving Cinder. Today is 2026-06-30. The latest entries about Yuki: 2025-10-27 rotation day, Diego hands pager to Yuki; 2025-10-13 cost review run by Yuki. No team change for Yuki.

So Yuki is on team Cinder.
